metadata.description: Optional lab analytic only; no deployment or runtime validation performed.

variables.queryBody:
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1d)
| extend ActorOid = tolower(coalesce(
    tostring(Claims_d["http://schemas.microsoft.com/identity/claims/objectidentifier"]),
    tostring(Claims_d.oid), Caller))
| where ActorOid == tolower(ActorObjectId)
| extend NormalizedResourceId = tolower(ResourceId)
| where NormalizedResourceId == LabGroup or NormalizedResourceId startswith LabPrefix
| extend ArrivalTime = coalesce(ingestion_time(), EventSubmissionTimestamp, TimeGenerated),
    ArrivalClock = case(isnotnull(ingestion_time()), "workspace_ingestion",
                        isnotnull(EventSubmissionTimestamp), "provider_submission", "event_time_fallback")
| where ArrivalTime > ago(20m) and ArrivalTime <= now()
| where tolower(ActivityStatusValue) in ("success", "succeeded")
| where tolower(OperationNameValue) in (
    "microsoft.storage/storageaccounts/listkeys/action",
    "microsoft.storage/storageaccounts/listaccountsas/action",
    "microsoft.storage/storageaccounts/listservicesas/action",
    "microsoft.storage/storageaccounts/regeneratekey/action",
    "microsoft.storage/storageaccounts/delete",
    "microsoft.authorization/locks/delete")
| where isnotempty(EventDataId)
| summarize arg_max(ArrivalTime, *) by EventDataId
| extend SignalPriority = case(tolower(OperationNameValue) endswith "/delete", 3,
                              tolower(OperationNameValue) endswith "/regeneratekey/action", 2, 1)
| order by SignalPriority desc, TimeGenerated asc, EventDataId asc
| take 1
| project TimeGenerated, ProviderEventTime = strcat(format_datetime(TimeGenerated, "yyyy-MM-dd"), "T", format_datetime(TimeGenerated, "HH:mm:ss.fffffff"), "Z"), ArrivalTime, ArrivalClock, EventSubmissionTimestamp, LabId = ConfiguredLabId,
    ActorObjectId = ActorOid, CallerIpAddress, ResourceId, OperationNameValue,
    ActivityStatusValue, ActivitySubstatusValue, CorrelationId, OperationId, EventDataId

properties.displayName: LAB Storm-3168 - scoped sensitive control-plane operation
properties.description: Lab-only successful sensitive operation from the exact actor/group; one candidate per evaluation with a 30-minute suppression window. Failed/denied operations remain hunting evidence. Not proof of compromise, no automatic response binding.
properties.query: [concat('let LabResourceGroupId = "', parameters('labResourceGroupId'), '"; let ActorObjectId = "', parameters('actorObjectId'), '"; let LabGroup = tolower(trim_end(@"/+", LabResourceGroupId)); let LabPrefix = strcat(LabGroup, "/"); ', 'let ConfiguredLabId = "', parameters('labId'), '"; ', variables('queryBody'))]
